notes: NO BRIDGE TO ATTESTED FAMILY — ~200-YEAR GAP (deep-chain audit, 2026-07-03): 'Durvassal' was a genuine armigerous Warwickshire family (Solihull/Coughton area — Philip, John, and Thomas Durvassal, coroner) but every attested member found dates to the 13th-14th century, roughly 150-200 years before this record's implied 16th-century dates (b. abt 1500, d. 1583). No source bridges the gap, and the surrounding cluster (husband 'John Sir of Wyke Holt-van Wyke', daughter 'Katherine Holt-van Wyke-de La Spine\Spinney, of Wyke') carries mechanically-generated hyphenated compound surnames typical of fabricated/recycled tree naming rather than a real family reconstruction. Recommend labeling this branch 'legend' pending a genuine Visitation or IPM citation. — WikiTree: Philip/John/Thomas Durvassal.
